name: Jump Lunge
instructions: Start in a lunge with the front knee at 90 degrees.
Land softly in the opposite lunge, absorbing through both legs.
Keep the torso tall and alternate continuously for reps or time.
longevityNotes: Single-leg strength is balance insurance — the ability to catch yourself on one leg prevents falls. Train lunges for control, not maximal load.
overview: Jump Lunge is an intermediate single-leg exercise for the quadriceps, performed with just your bodyweight. Training one leg at a time builds balance and evens out side-to-side differences.
